audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 were given to Ornn while whys[1] calls level 2 'a farm fest, neither side has kill pressure' and whys[2] calls level 3 'still a skill lane'.
audit.why: 48.48% win rate over 1417 games and a packet chart of Skill through level 6 — the lane is genuinely neutral until Ornn's item spike.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had only 3 entries — a structural gap flagged in packet.defects.
audit.why: Zaahen's passive, Determination, fills from attacks and abilities against champions and lets him revive at full stacks. That is a real fourth power point and nothing in the page mentions it.
audit.corrected: Created spikes[3] with before:null describing the revive, so a won fight is not assumed over.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Zaahen ability was named anywhere — the tracked cooldown was literally the word 'Ultimate' in focus.text, loading, breakdowns, dos and don'ts.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s) is an auto-attack reset that heals and can be recast for a knock-up. Dreaded Return (W, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, 850 range) stabs and pulls you in. Aureate Rush (E, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) is a dash that deals max-health damage, so armour alone reads the trade wrong. Grim Deliverance (R, 110/95/80s) heals him for a portion of damage dealt. Aureate Rush carries the dash flag and Ornn's Q grounds — that is the lane's decisive interaction.
audit.corrected: Named all four abilities, moved the tracked cooldown to Aureate Rush, and stated the grounding denial.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown section named no ability and no number.
audit.why: Aureate Rush at 10s rank 1 is the repeatable window that decides trades; Grim Deliverance at 110s is the big one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is absent from itemization despite two healing abilities.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive heals on cast and Grim Deliverance heals for a portion of damage dealt — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d rather than rewriting the itemization string, which is at its length limit.

edits.before: Brittle his combo and out-scale him. Track Ultimate before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Brittle his combo and out-scale him. Track Aureate Rush before every commit and keep the wave yours.

edits.before: Zaahen wins by landing Ultimate, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Zaahen wins by pulling you with W, dashing on top of you, and out-trading your engage windows.

edits.before: - Ornn vs Zaahen - Track: Zaahen Ultimate. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage only on Ultimate's cooldown. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ornn vs Zaahen - Track: Zaahen Aureate Rush, 10s. - Keep the wave on your side. - Engage when his dash is down. - Don't chase past the wave. - Ultimate = kill windows only.

edits.before: - Zaahen Ultimate: matchup-defining — His big cooldown. Brittle around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Aureate Rush (E): 10s at rank 1 — it is a dash, so your Q grounding pins him for the knock-up. - Dreaded Return (W): 14s pull from 850. - Grim Deliverance (R): 110s and it heals him, so bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Track Zaahen's Ultimate: His big cooldown. Brittle around it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Aureate Rush (E) is a 10s dash and Volcanic Rupture grounds it — hold Q for his step-up.

edits.before: His big cooldown. Brittle around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Aureate Rush is his 10s dash — ground it with Q and he has no way out.

edits.before: Zaahen wastes Ultimate — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His dash is spent — 10 seconds, so commit the pattern now.

edits.before: That is Zaahen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The Darkin Glaive is an auto reset — the windup is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His Q and R both heal him — Grievous Wounds before any long trade.
Determination fills late and he can revive at full stacks — a won fight is not over, so hold R's knock-up for the second life.

notes: Zaahen ability names are not in packet.enemyAbilities (null); they were taken from the missingInteractions headlines, which name The Darkin Glaive (Q), Dreaded Return (W), Aureate Rush (E) and Grim Deliverance (R) alongside Ornn's own. If those names are wrong upstream, every naming edit here inherits the error. The spikes[3] gap flagged in packet.defects is filled with the passive revive, which is stated in Riot's own text.
